stem:
Chetan's school in Bengaluru asks students to choose travel habits that reduce fossil-fuel use for a 2 km trip to a nearby park.

Which choice best does that, and why?

options.text: Use half as much petrol each day so that the remaining petrol will run out twice as fast.
Cut back on solar-panel use so that sunlight does not run out.
Walk, cycle or share a full public bus for nearby trips, because that lowers petrol or diesel burned per person.
Always pick the smallest private car, because the smallest vehicle must use the least fuel per traveller.

teacher.key_rationale: Lowering fossil-fuel consumption for short trips conserves limited fuels. A reverses consumption–lifetime; B applies exhaustion logic to sunlight; D judges by vehicle size instead of fuel per traveller.
